payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute prefix/suffix LNDS lengths and zero/one counts, then greedily flip 1s to 0s when an exchange condition shows the global LNDS length is preserved.
payload.rationale: The solution processes the string linearly, for each '1' checks a condition involving prefix/suffix statistics to decide whether setting it to '0' would break any substring's LNDS, thereby maximizing zeros via a greedy exchange argument.
